text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
THE TIMES - Eight new faces elected in elections on Thursday to fill seats given up by candidates who were elected from two divisions in the October 26 elections.
- Mid-Med Bank pre-tax profits up by 37 percent to Lm12.7 million ($35.56m) .
L-ORIZZONT - Prime Minister Alfred Sant to meet Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi in Rome on Saturday. It will be Sant's first meeting with a head of government since his election on October 26.
- Tunisian arrested at the airport after heroin found in his possession.
IN-NAZZJON - Parliament to have four women after election.
